name: The Dead Sea
short_desc: The center of the world drains & rises, crossing is dangerous but going around is slow.
long_desc:
A sea surrounded by continents, on a cycle almost predictable, 3 or 4 weeks at most, it drains. Little life survives within longer than a cycle.
And when it returns, with storm and thunder, it takes from all which surrounds it.
Crossing is dangerous but going around is slow.

name: The Living City
short_desc: An evergrowth born of a Great Tree, an infectious paradise for those within.
long_desc: Mikiltré, the Living City is a paradise to many, growing & changing to house and feed those within. It's spores spreading, changing, and joining them.

name: Wurmspeil
short_desc: Nestled in the mountains, fed by meat and herbs, it's spires rise to the skies.
long_desc: The spires of Wurmspeil prefer to keep their secrets close, though oft recognizable by their draconic symbols & potions brewed Levensblad, a restorative but mildly psychadelic herb found in the cold.

name: The ??? Dominion
short_desc: In the Desert rises an oasis of marble and gardens, of euphoria for the privileged.
long_desc: The Dominion has ever been a force upon the sands, where great houses drive daggers held by "indentured servants" into each other. Though they may live long, they do not live cheap.

name: Blasting Hollow
short_desc: The sun burns the dreamer, the refugees, and the mad. But it does not burn the minerals below.
long_desc: Unclaimed by any others, Blasting Hollow rests in a mineral rich salt flat. Favoured by inventors, it has become the home to automaton development & gunpowder experimentation, though little of it escapes the valley.

name: The Lands of Ash
short_desc: The home of devils and demons.
long_desc: Though it's location disputed, any true born devil or demon knows the way. An near inhospitable wasteland split between law and war, devouring itself. No wonder they seek escape.

name: Flotsam Archipelago
short_desc: Not everyone manages to cross the sea.
long_desc: When a ship sails too late and meets a terrible end, the scavengers come, and colllect. On the deep ocean, they build homes, survive.

name: Wurmpass
long_desc: A dangerous road, leading to Wurmspiel and beyond. Tight passages, and unstable ground makes this road a deadly step for many a traveller.

name: Ordahl
short_desc: Once a gleaming home, now it's ruins are infested with the dead.
long_desc: Before the Bog Sickness, Ordahl was a major trade & mining hub. Much of it's riches still reamain within the walls, protected by the dead. Many have entered, few have left.
